description_en: Manages digital SMS signature operation orders
description_zh: 数字短信签名操作订单
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-digital-sign-order --order-type CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN --submitter 110000001750080 --sign-name '阿里云商城' --qualification-id 41 --qualification-version 49 --order-context qualificationLegalPersonName=张三 qualificationAdminName=李四 qualificationCompanyName=阿里阿巴 qualificationLegalPersonIDCard=110105199001011234 qualificationOrganizationCode=91330106MA2A0XABCD qualificationAdminIDCard=110105199001010000 --sign-industry 0 --sign-id 80 --sign-source 0 --extend-message example --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDigitalSignOrder

parameters.help_en:
Required. The request type. Specifies the signature management operation to perform based on the enumeration type.
UPDATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN (update)
DELETE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN (delete)
CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN (create)
parameters.help_zh:
必填。请求类型，按照枚举类型进行签名管理的新增、编辑、删除操作。
UPDATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（更新）
DELETE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（删除）
CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（创建）
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The signature name. This field is required for create, update, and delete operations.

Only pure Chinese, Chinese-English, Chinese-number, or English-number combinations are supported. The character length is limited to 2 to 16 characters.

Input restrictions:
Special characters are prohibited, including but not limited to "$, &, %, #, @, !, ^, *, (, ), _, +, -, =, {, }, [, ], |, ;, :, ', \", <, >, ,, ., /, ?, ~, `".
Pure English letters are not supported.
Pure numbers are not accepted. Spaces are strictly prohibited, whether single or multiple consecutive spaces.
Emojis are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
签名名称。创建/更新/删除当前字段必填。

仅支持纯中文、中英文、中文+数字、英文+数字组合输入，字符长度限制2~16字符以内。

输入限制规则：
禁止任何特殊字符输入，包括但不限于 “$、&、%、#、@、!、^、*、(、)、_、+、-、=、{、}、[、]、|、;、:、'、"、<、>、,、.、/、?、~、`” 等特殊符号
不支持纯英文字母输入
不接受纯数字输入严格禁止输入空格，无论是单个空格还是多个连续空格
不允许输入emoji
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The qualification information. This field is required during creation and required during update if you need to change the qualification information.
qualificationCompanyName: The enterprise name. Only middle dots (·), Chinese brackets (【】（）), English parentheses (()), and spaces are supported. Other symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length cannot exceed 150 characters.
qualificationOrganizationCode: The unified social credit code of the enterprise (18 characters). Only unified social credit codes consisting of 18 digits or uppercase/lowercase English letters are supported.
qualificationAdminName: The name of the administrator (in Chinese). The name of the legal representative.
qualificationAdminIDCard: The ID card number of the administrator (18 characters). Only ID cards are currently supported. The data validation format is the ID card format (digits + letters, 18 characters).
qualificationLegalPersonName: The name of the legal representative or administrator.
qualificationLegalPersonIDCard: The ID card number (18 characters). Only ID cards are currently supported. The data validation format is the ID card format (digits + letters, 18 characters)
parameters.help_zh:
资质信息，在这个结构中，在【创建】时必填，【更新】时需要变更资质信息则必填
qualificationCompanyName：企业名称。符号仅支持中点·、中文【】（）、英文()及空格，不可含其他符号或纯数字，长度不超过150字符
qualificationOrganizationCode：企业社会信用代码（18位），仅支持统一社会信用，18位数字或大小写英文字母组成的代码
qualificationAdminName：经办人姓名（中文），法定代表人姓名。
qualificationAdminIDCard：经办人身份证号（18位）当前只支持身份证，数据校验格式为身份证格式（数字+字母 18位）
qualificationLegalPersonName：法人姓名/经办人姓名。
qualificationLegalPersonIDCard：身份证号（18位） 当前只支持身份证，数据校验格式为身份证格式（数字+字母 18位）
parameters.name: order_context

parameters.help_en:
The industry type.
0: General (GENERAL). 1: E-commerce and retail (ECOMMERCE).
This field is required when creating or updating a signature. It is optional when deleting a signature
parameters.help_zh:
行业类型
0：通用（GENERAL）；1：电商零售（ECOMMERCE）。
新增/更新签名时，当前字段必填；删除时非必填
parameters.name: sign_industry

parameters.help_en: The signature ID. A unique identifier for the signature in the system
parameters.help_zh: 签名ID-系统内唯一签名标识
parameters.name: sign_id

parameters.help_en:
The signature source.   
This field is required when creating or updating a signature. It is optional when deleting a signature.
0: Enterprise or public institution. 2: App. 4: E-commerce or flagship store. 5: Trademark name
parameters.help_zh:
签名来源   
新增/更新签名时，当前字段必填；删除时非必填。
0：企事业单位；2：App应用；4：电商/旗舰店；5：商标名
parameters.name: sign_source

The response body.
signName: The signature name. The name of the created signature.
signOrderId: The signature order ID. The unique identifier of the associated signature order.
signCode: The signature code. The unique numeric ID of the signature in the system.
signId: The signature ID. The unique numeric ID of the signature in the system

signId：签名ID，签名在系统中的唯一数字ID
